runner: Playwright with installed Chrome, local disposable database

checks.name: Three distinct browser contexts authenticate independently
Owner drags a task; member receives task.moved and sees the committed move without reload
Keyboard Space/ArrowRight/Space moves a task through the drag-and-drop library
Third incoming move is rejected with HTTP 409; UI rolls back and WIP remains exactly two
Existing assignment, checklist, label, comments and authenticated private download render correctly
Comment, checklist addition/toggle and label mutations persist through the actual UI/API
Activity timeline shows real committed move/comment/checklist/label records
Outsider cannot open the private board or download a guessed attachment ID
Owner creates a real single-use invitation; matching registered guest accepts via UI
Desktop, tablet and mobile board/dialog layouts stay usable with intentional board scrolling
Logout clears the workspace and leaves no access token in browser storage
